cases.provenance: Fictional media-export row classifier. The working-only base misses waiting jobs; its broad phase repair handles waiting/no-receipt but misclassifies final receipts with null phase.

request.title: Include waiting exports in job admission
request.description: Classify only the supplied export jobs. A job without a receipt is unresolved even when its phase is stale; a final receipt is settled.

followUps.description: Prior review of the working-only classifier: a waiting export job with no receipt is unresolved and must make canStartExport return false.

expectedDefects.invariant: A sole job with null phase and ok receipt has finished and must permit another export. Waiting/null and null/null jobs still deny admission.

evidence.description: The new phase-only filter includes a finished null/ok job as unresolved, while a done/null job would be excluded despite having no receipt.

cases.provenance: Fictional later follow-up: the final-receipt finding can arise from the broad-phase base, and the equivalent every-by-phase rewrite leaves it unresolved.

request.title: Simplify export phase classification
request.description: Express the existing phase rule as an every check. The prior final-receipt review remains open until the classifier uses the receipt contract.

followUps.description: Prior review of the working-only classifier: a waiting export job with no receipt is unresolved and must make canStartExport return false.

Prior review of the broad phase classifier: a job with null phase and ok receipt has finished and must let canStartExport return true when it is the only row. Jobs without a receipt remain unresolved.

cases.provenance: Fictional corrected media-export classifier. The receipt-based rule covers all phase/receipt pairs admitted by the source Schema.

request.title: Classify export jobs by final receipts
request.description: A non-null receipt settles a job even when phase is stale; a null receipt is unresolved for every phase.

followUps.description: Prior review of the working-only classifier: a waiting export job with no receipt is unresolved and must make canStartExport return false.

Prior review of the broad phase classifier: a job with null phase and ok receipt has finished and must let canStartExport return true when it is the only row. Jobs without a receipt remain unresolved.
